shared_elements: human figure in long garment (partial, at edge)
band of repeated ornament bordering the field
fringed/pleated drapery rendered as parallel lines
justification: Both surfaces use the same specific repertoire of a multi-petalled rosette repeated as border ornament, robed human figures shown in profile with parallel-line drapery, and a hand closed around a held object, all in shallow relief organised into horizontal registers. The decisive difference is subject: A is dominated by dense rows of wedge-like script signs with figures only at the margins, whereas B shows a continuous procession of tribute-bearers carrying bowls and vessels toward a leading figure, with no writing at all.
